noticeRules.1: Before pickup, inspect the vehicle/battery status and confirm the item is in good condition and working order.
noticeRules.2: Only the person who placed the order may pick up the item; proxy pickup is not supported.
noticeRules.3: Damage to the vehicle/battery will be compensated at the actual repair cost.
noticeRules.4: Please comply with local traffic regulations and ride safely.
noticeRules.5: Inventory is subject to on-site store stock; we recommend contacting the store in advance to confirm or consult.

orders.selfPickupReturn: Pick up & return at the store by yourself
orders.returnReminder: 7 days left in the rental period, please return to the store on time

renewRules.1: Auto renewal is enabled by default and the renewal fee is deducted from the wallet balance; the system initiates the charge automatically before the due date: {n} minutes before the due date for hourly plans, and {n} days before the due date for other plans.
renewRules.2: The system attempts the charge at most {n} times. If the charge succeeds, the renewal takes effect and the order is extended automatically; if all charge attempts fail, auto renewal for the order will be terminated.
renewRules.3: If auto renewal fails, you can go to the order details page to renew manually; eligible order types and statuses follow the store configuration, and any unpaid renewal order must be paid first.

billingRules.1: The rental start time is when the user binds the vehicle/battery.
billingRules.2: Rent is calculated based on the rental plan selected for the order (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly).
billingRules.3: If the rental duration is less than 1 billing period, it is charged as 1 full period.

overdueRules.1: Please return the vehicle/battery within the time agreed in the order.
overdueRules.2: In case of overdue return, the merchant may deduct the related overdue charges from the deposit.
overdueRules.3: If the deposit is insufficient to cover the deduction, the merchant has the right to claim the difference from the user.
overdueRules.4: If the vehicle is not returned beyond the agreed number of days, the merchant has the right to remotely lock the vehicle and restrict battery discharge.

cancelRules.1: If the order has not been paid, the user may cancel it on their own.
cancelRules.2: If the order has been paid but the vehicle/battery has not been picked up, the user may cancel it on their own.
cancelRules.3: After picking up the vehicle/battery, cancellation requires negotiation with the merchant; the actual refund is subject to the agreement between both parties.
cancelRules.4: Rent and deposit will be refunded via the original payment method within 7 business days after the order is canceled.

pushNotify.renewReminderBodyTpl: Your order will auto renew on {dueDate} and be charged {amount}. If renewal is not needed, please go to the order details to turn off auto renewal.
pushNotify.renewSuccessBodyTpl: Your order has been auto renewed successfully and {amount} was charged. The order is now valid until {newDueDate}.
pushNotify.renewFailedBodyTpl: Your order auto renewal failed (attempt {failCount}/{threshold}). Insufficient balance. Please top up as soon as possible, otherwise too many failed renewals will turn off auto renewal.
pushNotify.orderCreatedBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has been created. Please complete payment within 30 minutes, otherwise the order will be cancelled automatically.
pushNotify.orderPaidBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has been paid successfully. Please scan the vehicle/battery QR code to complete binding as soon as possible; billing starts once bound.
pushNotify.deviceBoundBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has been bound with the vehicle/battery. Rental period: {rentStart} to {rentEnd}.
pushNotify.orderExpiringBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} will expire on {rentEnd}. Please return it at the store on time, or renew it from the order details.
pushNotify.orderOverdueBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has expired. Please return it at the store as soon as possible to avoid extra charges; if you still need it, you can renew it from the order details.
pushNotify.orderBreachBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} is {days} days overdue and the vehicle and battery have been remotely locked. Please contact the store immediately.
pushNotify.orderCompletedBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has been completed. Thank you for your business and we look forward to serving you again.
pushNotify.orderCancelledBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} has been cancelled. The paid amount will be refunded to the original payment method.
pushNotify.orderAdjustedBodyTpl: The amount of your order {orderNo} has been adjusted from {oldAmount} to {newAmount}. Please contact the store if you have any questions.
pushNotify.orderRefundingBodyTpl: Your order {orderNo} is being refunded. Refund amount: {amount}, expected to be returned to the original payment method within 1–7 business days.
pushNotify.orderRefundedBodyTpl: {amount} for order {orderNo} has been refunded to the original payment method. Please check your account.
